commitResults.messageBody:
The d/ prefix is used generically for dates across appointment,
payment, and attendance commands. The old name was misleading.

@param was 'appointmentStart' but the actual parameter
is 'paymentDate'.

Double-escaped newlines caused backslash-n to appear
literally in help text instead of actual newlines.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move LocalDateTime.now() from EditAttdCommand to parser
commitResults.messageBody:
The command now accepts a concrete LocalDateTime, making it
deterministic and testable. The parser resolves the default
timestamp when the user does not supply a date.

commitResults.messageBody:
LogicManager now compares before/after hash codes to
avoid unnecessary disk I/O for read-only commands like
find, list, and help.

Tests for missing index, zero index, and negative index
were absent from EditCommandParserTest. Added all three

commitResults.messageTitle: Move LocalDate.now() from ViewApptCommand to parser
commitResults.messageBody:
ViewApptCommand now always requires an explicit LocalDate,
making it deterministic and testable. The parser resolves
LocalDate.now() as the default when no date is provided.
